stories.title: Reconcile prototype interfaces and shared rules
stories.dod: Record source precedence and missing GDD assumptions; map actual reusable functions and data. Keep local playable scope distinct from later service integration.

stories.title: Create local app shell and persistent shared state
stories.dod: One landscape shell with shared wallet, navigation and versioned local saves; reload retains progress; local Git/build commands documented.

stories.title: Reuse roster and wire crew placement
stories.dod: Import all 36 actual roster rows and stats; eight-level station ladder; no duplicate or locked placements; collection/details and loadout persist.

stories.title: Embed supplied water and ship rendering
stories.dod: Reuse water and hull shaders, expose lifecycle API, render two ships over water and handle resize/WebGL failure without rebuilding effects.

stories.title: Connect attacks to damage, crew and rig effects
stories.dod: Player aims at enemy; shared weapon/target rules drive hull, sail and crew state; supplied scatter, mask, burn and mast effects respond to hits.

stories.title: Complete playable battle turns and outcomes
stories.dod: Two shots per turn baseline, enemy turns, damage/accuracy, victory/loss and round cap; controls lock during resolution; saved match can recover.

stories.title: Reuse opponent simulation and temperament
stories.dod: Use supplied seeded captain/rating/loadout logic as reference for real roster opponents; enemy actions and emotes reflect temperament and current crew.

stories.title: Build result, learning and rematch flow
stories.dod: Loss-only one rematch, simulated 65% acceptance and -20% accuracy; refusal grants nothing; results explain damage/rewards and no defeat sales pitch.

stories.title: Wire rewards, chest contents and daily capacity
stories.dod: Full win gold/one chest, one-third loss gold; four tiers and specific-pirate cards; five slots, daily reset without discarded contents; once-only claims and fifth-chest gems.

stories.title: Wire gunsmith timers and ship progression
stories.dod: Cards/gold upgrades, persisted bench timer and gem skip; approved materials ship ladder; no negative wallets or duplicate completion.

stories.title: Wire port hauls and Trade Shop exchange
stories.dod: Trade material surplus with fee/stock limits; smaller stay haul and travel haul; first-visit gem award once.

stories.title: Reuse Ports chart and board presentation
stories.dod: Use supplied port list/chart and ranking behavior; 100-seat boards, own row and captain scouting; no progression level gates.

stories.title: Persist weekly standings and promotion
stories.dod: Monday reset with deterministic tie ordering; top/bottom ten movement with bounds; one settlement/haul per week; local clock limitations documented.

stories.title: Wire equipment, canvas and repairs
stories.dod: Supplied plating/canvas protection, wear and material repairs; worn equipment never blocks battle; costs shown and state saved.

stories.title: Wire enhancements, figureheads and cosmetic loadout
stories.dod: Reuse supplied four-system and six-figurehead tables; one equipped figurehead, permanent upgrades and gold-only sail cosmetics influence/display correctly.

stories.title: Wire all six finishing moves into battle
stories.dod: Four consecutive dual-hit turns charge selected owned move once per match; each move affects its specified target; poster/animation/cheer and timer pause/short repeat mode.

stories.title: Reuse Booty track and persistent claims
stories.dod: 50-level free/paid track with aligned wide cells, current-level focus and single/bulk claim; progress/claims persist; local premium demonstration clearly separate from real purchase.

stories.title: Wire quests and season lifecycle
stories.dod: Match/daily/weekly progress grants XP once; season clock and rollover/catch-up policy explicit; unlocked moves survive rollover.

stories.title: Build Store from supplied catalog and offers
stories.dod: Six gem packs/four bundles, item/offer layouts, max three offers, real expiry/cooldown, no loss trigger; no fake charge or misleading real purchase success.

stories.title: Reuse existing pirate art and unify presentation
stories.dod: Inspect supplied segmented images; use suitable art in crew/battle/UI, preserve source attribution, shared palette/type and readable landscape layouts.

stories.title: Add onboarding, sound and accessibility settings
stories.dod: First-run explains placement/aim/finisher/rewards; mute and reduced-motion controls, keyboard/focus, Escape sheets, minimum tap targets and usable error states.

stories.title: Verify battle and progression invariants
stories.dod: Meaningful tests cover placement, battle outcomes/rematch, wallet/claims/timers, weekly/season rollover and restart; all pass and source-model discrepancies recorded.

stories.title: Run browser QA and deliver local game
stories.dod: Play through shell→crew→battle→result→rewards→upgrade; inspect landscape/PC views, console and WebGL; fix defects; provide local URL/start command and truthful limitations.

stories.title: Add remote authority and account synchronization
stories.dod: Follow-up beyond local target: configured account/service saves, conflict/retry and cross-device sync with authoritative economy/time; requires chosen service and credentials.

stories.title: Connect shared player boards and ghost population
stories.dod: Follow-up: submit verified scores, replace seeds with real profiles and server-side settlement; no claim that local seeded opponents are network players.

stories.title: Connect real storefront purchases and restore
stories.dod: Follow-up: selected provider sandbox receipts, restore/cancel/pending/duplicate callback coverage; live enablement separate. Local build must not simulate real payment success.

stories.title: Complete missing production art and audio
stories.dod: Follow-up: inspect remaining asset gaps against all 36 pirates/six finishers; replace only missing placeholders and obtain owner art acceptance; no blanket recreation of supplied art.

stories.title: Validate live release readiness
stories.dod: Follow-up: real target-phone performance, network/purchase recovery and owner acceptance; platform distribution/GitHub connection separate from local build.
